title: 2 · They need care in Taifafeki and share the IPS
description: In Lumara, Sefa has an asthma attack and goes to a walk-in clinic. At the front desk they open their wallet and show the QR code; Kito scans it into the clinic's system. Sefa chooses to share; nothing is sent from Onesa.
where: A walk-in clinic in Lumara, Taifafeki

Flags only of the fictional countries: Onesa (indigo over orange, white star) and Taifafeki (teal, gold sun and gold bar). All people are fictional.
